## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run validate` and it passes
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/quality-gate.js` and it passes
- [ ] New skills follow the format in `docs/skill-anatomy.md`
- [ ] YAML frontmatter has `name` and `description` fields
- [ ] Description includes both "what" and "when" signals
- [ ] Skill has Overview, When to Use, Common Rationalizations, Red Flags, and Verification sections
- [ ] Cross-skill references point to existing skills
- [ ] No duplicate content between skills (reference instead)
